lines.text: InkAgent. Firmware for the Xteink readers.
Not an app. The whole device.
The agent lives in the firmware.
And the first thing it offers is, question me on this.
What comes back is a question.
Answering is forbidden.
Because reading with a chatbot tests worse than reading alone.
Being asked is what holds.
It also reads how you read. From page turns alone.
How often you went back, and your pace.
Two numbers, and nothing else.
Underneath, a serious reader.
An offline dictionary.
Your own fonts.
Tilt to turn the page.
Calibre, and KOReader sync.
Reader to reader, with nothing in between.
Every word you look up comes back.
Your highlights in one list. An inbox that empties.
And the sleep screen spends itself on your book.
Apps are a JSON file on the card.
It appears in the drawer. No firmware build.
And nothing here can follow you into a book.
InkAgent. Bring your own model.
